what_it_is: GalaxEye Space is a Bengaluru-based earth-observation startup building the Drishti constellation, positioned as the world's first commercial OptoSAR satellites fusing multispectral optical and SAR imaging in a single platform for all-weather day-and-night imaging. Founded by IIT Madras alumni, the company raised seed and Series A rounds and flew an earlier 35 kg-class proof satellite (Drishti-1/Drishti mission) before the flagship.
india_angle: Mission Drishti launched in May 2026 on an Indian launcher and was publicly noted by the Prime Minister's Office as the world's first OptoSAR satellite and the largest privately-built Indian satellite to date - a landmark for India's private EO sector. The programme anchors India's emerging commercial remote-sensing supply chain.
intelligence_assessment: GalaxEye's launch milestone is among the strongest verified India signals in the space vertical. Constellation economics, sensor fusion performance and customer pipeline are still largely vendor-stated; validate against independent imagery analysis and follow-on satellite deliveries rather than the single-satellite headline.
